Broad spp. labels do not identify one species. An unresolved name is not biological absence.
Only native scientificName or explicit synonyms match; otherNames and substrings do not resolve.
Protein reference, exact allele, experimental strain/genome and compound-specific primary review remain open.
Taxonomy completion does not revalidate inherited resistance assertions or create new phenotype claims.
